title: Mir Mine
description: This hole beside a city is more than 500 meters deep. The Mir mine in Siberia was dug for diamonds, and it is still giving them up. Imagery: Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics. Photos: Vladimir (CC BY 3.0), Wikimedia Commons. Source: Wikipedia.

beats.text: This hole beside a city is more than five hundred meters deep.
It is the Mir mine in Siberia, and it was dug for diamonds.
The pit is twelve hundred meters wide.
In the nineteen sixties it gave ten million carats of diamonds a year.
Digging was brutal. Seven months of winter froze the ground hard.
Open mining stopped in two thousand one. Now tunnels reach the diamonds from below.
And in twenty twenty five, it gave up the largest diamond ever mined in Russia.
